allOf $ref CP_MODULE_PAYLOAD_BASE.schema.txt
properties
  module_id const CP-0
  module_name const SourceReadiness
  owned_object const source_readiness_register
  schema_family const Nested
  runtime_output type object
    required input_gate source_register source_hierarchy content_to_module_map
      gaps_ledger conflict_ledger evidence_trace readiness_summary
      routing_recommendation recommended_run_commands master_index_state verification
    properties
      input_gate type object
        required run_id objective preparation_run_id preparation_registers preparation_validation
        properties
          run_id type string
          issuer type string null
          period type string null
          objective type string
          preparation_run_id type string
          preparation_registers type string
          preparation_validation enum PASS FAIL
          source_status enum Received Partial Missing
          limitation type string null
      source_register type array minItems 1 items type object
        required logical_source_id original_source_id original_file_name active_content_file_name
          authority_quality extraction_confidence usability_verdict
        properties
          logical_source_id type string
          original_source_id type string
          original_file_name type string
          active_content_file_name type string null
          active_content_artifact_id type string null
          authority_quality type string
          extraction_confidence enum HIGH MEDIUM LOW FAILED
          usability_verdict enum Usable Usable_with_Limitations Conditional Not_Usable
          downstream_modules_supported type array items type string
          limitation_flags type array items type string
      source_hierarchy type array items type object
        required priority source_class authority_rule files_present missing_minimum
        properties
          priority enum 1 2 3 4
          source_class type string
          authority_rule type string
          files_present type array items type string
          missing_minimum type array items type string
          downstream_use type array items type string
      content_to_module_map type array items type object
        required module_id evidence_demand active_representation_ids readiness_status readiness_effect
        properties
          module_id type string
          evidence_demand type string
          active_representation_ids type array items type string
          readiness_status enum READY READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS CONDITIONAL BLOCKED
          readiness_effect type string
      gaps_ledger type array items type object
        properties
          gap_id type string
          type enum SOURCE_GAP PREPARATION_GAP COVERAGE_GAP LOCATOR_GAP STALE_EVIDENCE OTHER
          severity enum CRITICAL MATERIAL MINOR
          affected_modules type array items type string
          remediation type string null
      conflict_ledger type array items type object
        properties
          conflict_id type string
          type type string
          severity enum CRITICAL MATERIAL MINOR
          affected_modules type array items type string
          description type string
      evidence_trace type array items type object
        required evidence_id original_source_id active_representation_id locator
        properties
          evidence_id type string
          original_source_id type string
          active_representation_id type string
          locator type string
      readiness_summary type object
        required overall_readiness source_count
        properties
          overall_readiness enum READY READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS CONDITIONAL BLOCKED
          critical_gaps type array items type string
          source_count type integer
      routing_recommendation type array items type object
        required module_id routing_status readiness_effect content_basis
        properties
          module_id type string
          routing_status enum Recommended Blocked Conditional
          readiness_effect type string
          content_basis type string
          limitation type string null
      recommended_run_commands type array items type object
        required sequence module_id candidate_command exact_command source_files_to_attach upstream_handoff readiness why_now_or_blocker
        properties
          sequence type integer minimum 1
          module_id enum CP-1 CP-1A CP-1B CP-1C CP-1D CP-2 CP-2A CP-2E CP-2G CP-2H CP-3 CP-4 CP-4C CP-5 CP-6 CP-8 CP-L10
          candidate_command type string pattern ^Run CP-
          exact_command type string
          source_files_to_attach type array items type string
          upstream_handoff type string
          readiness enum READY READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS CONDITIONAL BLOCKED
          why_now_or_blocker type string
        rules
          READY READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS require exact_command equals candidate_command
          CONDITIONAL BLOCKED require exact_command const DO NOT RUN
          candidate_command module identifier equals module_id
      model_route_source_assessment type object
        required status assertion_scope required_downstream_handoffs optional_downstream_handoffs cp_model_input_contract next_action
        properties
          status const SOURCE_READY_FOR_MODEL_ROUTE
          assertion_scope const SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_ONLY
          required_downstream_handoffs const CP-1 CP-1A CP-1B CP-2 CP-2A
          optional_downstream_handoffs const CP-2G
          cp_model_input_contract const NOT_EVALUATED
          next_action type string pattern ^Run CP-(1|1A|1B|2|2A|2G)
      master_index_state type object
        required master_index_id issuer_id_name preparation_registers canonical_handoff downstream_consumers
        properties
          master_index_id type string
          issuer_id_name type string
          preparation_registers type string
          canonical_handoff type string
          downstream_consumers type array items type string
      verification type object
        required cp_parse_lineage inventory_complete representation_unique
          authority_quality_separated gaps_conflicts downstream_readiness model_boundary canonical_markdown
        properties
          cp_parse_lineage enum PASS FAIL
          inventory_complete enum PASS FAIL
          representation_unique enum PASS FAIL
          authority_quality_separated enum PASS FAIL
          gaps_conflicts enum PASS FAIL
          downstream_readiness enum PASS FAIL
          model_boundary enum PASS FAIL NA
          canonical_markdown enum PASS FAIL
